# Fictional brand logos

Protea Bank (a bank) and NimbusMail (a mail provider) are fictional brands, invented and drawn by IsItLegit for its tests, demo and fixture sites (design spec section 11, Fixtures). They imitate no real company. The SVG files are the sources; `node scripts/fixtures/make-brand-logos.ts` renders the PNGs, which the reference logo store (`scripts/load-reference-logos.ts`, D03 T03 §2) loads with `fictional: true`. Real brands' logos are never committed here.
